items.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
items.description: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”

items.title: Will Anthropic pull off a November IPO? Time is running out to file key paperwork.
items.description: If market pressures keep building, Anthropic “could reasonably decide it is better to stay private and wait for a better opportunity,” one portfolio manager says.

items.title: Investors piled a record sum into a leveraged semiconductor ETF last week. Things didn’t work out.
items.description: Traders making bullish bets on chip stocks are getting walloped this month, as renewed fears emerged about investment returns on the buildout of artificial intelligence.

items.title: The mobile ambitions of SpaceX are hitting telecom stocks again. Here’s what the latest developments mean.
items.description: Reports of Starlink’s discussions with cell-tower owners were noticed by shareholders of Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile.

items.title: The real test for Moderna’s cancer vaccine isn’t about beating Keytruda. It’s keeping cancer from coming back in the long term.
items.description: The first Phase 3 data for a cancer vaccine has raised questions about whether the potential new treatment is needed.

items.title: The U.S. economy is great by this measure, and the good times aren’t over. So why are Americans so sour?
items.description: A once-in-a-generation investment boom has created lots of winners — but many Americans are feeling left out.

items.title: Oil markets are on edge ahead of the weekend, as midterm elections near and fresh U.S. strikes on Iran are predicted
items.description: Oil has climbed back to an Iran-war high and may soon go higher, if the U.S. and Israel strike Iran after their respective voters go to the polls in the coming days.

items.title: I want to pay off $4,500 in credit-card debt in 2 months. Is this possible?
items.description: “I’m 32 years old and feel like I should know how to do this stuff by now.”
